select u.user_id as person_id, u.user_name as person_code, u.nick_name as person_name from sys_user u where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) and not exists( select 1 from pm_project_member m where m.project_id = #{projectId} and m.user_id = u.user_id and m.status = 'ACTIVE' ) order by u.user_id limit 20
